client_frame: **The first Warsh NFP was a decisive miss: −23,000 payrolls vs ~+80–90k consensus, AHE soft at +3.2% YoY, and May/June revised down a net −103,000.** Unemployment falling to 4.1% is the one tight-looking print, but the level of jobs destruction + revisions dominates. Markets did the textbook soft-landing/recession-insurance trade: SPX to a **verified new closing ATH 7,757.64**, NDX +1.19% (still not June ATH), VIX to 14.90, gold +2%, BTC +1%, and **Sept odds flipped to hold-favored (~56–60%)** from hike-leaning. That is a large two-week swing in the policy path. **Weekend caveats**: (1) Berkshire Q2 due ~8am Sat — treat as color when it drops, not yet in this build; (2) Iran framework still unfinalized — oil trap remains if talks fail; (3) VIX 14.90 into a CPI week is complacent — Wed CPI is the next real test of whether soft labor = soft inflation. **Client message**: The labor side of the Warsh hawk case just took a body blow; do not assume the hold pricing sticks until CPI/PPI confirm disinflation. Prefer quality duration and balanced growth over pure cyclical chase on one NFP print. NDX is a recovery rally still −3% under June — not price discovery at highs. Keep some event vol into Wed CPI.
